findings.title: Use of renamed helper function without renaming parameter
findings.body: The renamed helper `_percentage` is used on line 11, but the parameter name `expected` still refers to the old semantic meaning (`expected` vs `total`). This breaks naming consistency within the same module and makes the code harder to follow. Rename the parameter to `total` to match the helper's contract.

summary.problem: The refactoring introduced a helper function `_percentage` but did not consistently rename parameters in its call sites, violating naming consistency rules.
summary.done_well: The helper function `_percentage` correctly handles edge cases (division by zero) and centralizes the percentage calculation logic.
